source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 12 (PDF 258-282), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Human Skeletal and Muscular Systems) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The internal framework of the body called skeleton is made of:
(Jism ka andaruni dhancha jise skeleton (dhancha) kehte hain, kis cheez se bana hai?)

options.text: bones, cartilage aur doosre connective tissues

blocks.explanation: Bones (haddiyan), cartilage (kurri) aur doosre connective tissues mil kar skeleton banate hain jo jism ko sahara deta, ahem aaza ki hifazat karta aur harkat paida karta hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: make an internal framework called skeleton that provides structural support

blocks.prompt:
2 The tough membrane covering the surface of a bone is called:
(Haddi ki satah ko dhanpne wali sakht jhilli ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Haddi ki satah periosteum naam ki sakht membrane (jhilli) se dhaki hoti hai; perichondrium cartilage ko gherti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: covered by a tough membrane called periosteum

blocks.prompt:
3 The thick, hard layer under the periosteum that makes up the majority of the bone tissue is:
(Periosteum ke neeche moti sakht teh jo haddi ke tissue ka zyada hissa banati hai, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Periosteum ke neeche moti teh compact bone hai; yahi haddi ke tissue ka zyada hissa hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It makes up the majority of the bone tissue

blocks.prompt:
4 The basic structural units of compact bone are:
(Compact bone ki bunyadi structural units kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Compact bone Haversian systems se bani hai; har system mein lamellae, lacunae (osteocytes ke saath) aur Haversian canal hoti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The basic structural units of compact bone are called Haversian systems

blocks.prompt:
5 The needle-shaped crystals in the lamellae of bone are made of:
(Haddi ki lamellae mein soi jaise crystals kis cheez ke hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lamellae mein collagen fibres aur calcium phosphate ke soi jaise crystals hote hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: small, needle-shaped crystals of calcium phosphate

blocks.prompt:
6 Bone is both strong and flexible because:
(Haddi mazboot bhi hai aur lachakdar bhi, kyun?)

options.text: calcium phosphate crystals sakht hain jab ke collagen lachakdar hai
collagen sakht hai jab ke crystals lachakdar hain
is ke matrix mein koi mineral nahi
yeh synovial fluid se dhaki hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Crystals sakht (rigid) hain jo taqat dete hain, collagen lachakdar hai; dono mil kar haddi ko mazboot aur lachakdar banate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: As a result, bone is both strong and flexible.

blocks.prompt:
7 In a Haversian system, the small spaces between lamellae in which osteocytes lie are called:
(Haversian system mein lamellae ke darmiyan chhoti jaghein jin mein osteocytes hote hain, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lamellae chhoti jaghon lacunae se alag hoti hain, aur in mein mature bone cells (osteocytes) hote hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Osteocytes, which are mature bone cells, are located in the lacunae.

blocks.prompt:
8 Osteocytes are connected to each other and to the Haversian canal by small channels called:
(Osteocytes aapas mein aur Haversian canal se kin chhoti naliyon ke zariye jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Canaliculi naam ki chhoti naliyan osteocytes ko aapas mein aur Haversian canal se jorti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: by small channels called canaliculi

blocks.prompt:
9 The central Haversian canal of a Haversian system contains:
(Haversian system ki darmiyani Haversian canal mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: blood vessels, nerves aur lymphatic vessels

blocks.explanation: Haversian canal mein blood vessels (khoon ki naliyan), nerves aur lymphatic vessels hoti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It contains blood vessels, nerves, and lymphatic vessels.

blocks.prompt:
10 The small channels that run perpendicular to the Haversian canals connect them with each other and with the:
(Haversian canals par amudi (perpendicular) chalne wali chhoti naliyan unhein aapas mein aur kis se jorti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amudi naliyan Haversian canals ko aapas mein aur periosteum se jorti hain; in mein bhi blood vessels, nerves aur lymphatic vessels hoti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: run perpendicular to the Haversian canals

blocks.prompt:
11 Spongy bone is light and strong because it has:
(Spongy bone halki aur mazboot kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spongy bone compact bone ke neeche hoti hai aur is mein haddi ke kaanton ka jaal (latticework) hota hai jo ise halka aur mazboot banata hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: latticework structure consisting of bony spikes

blocks.prompt:
12 The broad ends of a long bone are called:
(Lambi haddi ke chaure siron ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chaure sire epiphysis kehlate hain; lambai ke darmiyani hisse ko diaphysis ya shaft kehte hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The broad ends of a bone are called epiphysis

blocks.prompt:
13 Red bone marrow produces:
(Red bone marrow kya banata hai?)

options.text: energy ke zakheere ke liye fat cells
red blood cells, platelets aur white blood cells

blocks.explanation: Red bone marrow (spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke sire, pasliyan, vertebrae, sternum aur pelvis mein) red cells, platelets aur white cells banata hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It produces red blood cells, platelets, and white blood cells.

blocks.prompt:
14 Yellow bone marrow fills the shafts of long bones and consists mostly of:
(Yellow bone marrow lambi haddiyon ke shaft mein hota hai aur zyada tar kis cheez se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yellow marrow zyada tar fat cells (charbi ke khaliye) hai aur energy ka zakheera hai; shadeed khoon behne par yeh red marrow ban sakta hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It consists mostly of fat cells and serves as an energy reserve.

blocks.prompt:
15 Despite their number and size, bones make up:
(Apni tadaad aur size ke bawajood haddiyan jism ke wazan ka kitna hissa hain?)

options.text: jism ke wazan ka 50% se zyada
jism ke wazan ka 20% se kam

blocks.explanation: Haddiyan jism ke wazan ka 20% se kam hain; yeh geeli, zinda tissues hain, khushk sakht cheezein nahi (12.1).

book_ref.quote: bones make up less than 20% of the body

blocks.prompt:
16 Bone-forming cells that synthesize and secrete unmineralized ground substance are:
(Woh bone banane wale cells jo unmineralized ground substance banate aur kharij karte hain, kaunse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Osteoblasts unmineralized ground substance kharij kar ke haddi banate hain; matrix mein ghir kar yeh osteocytes ban jate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Osteoblasts are bone forming cells that synthesize

blocks.prompt:
17 Osteoclasts develop from:
(Osteoclasts kis se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Osteoclasts macrophages se bante hain aur bone resorption (haddi ko tor kar jazb karna) karte hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Osteoclasts develop from macrophages

blocks.prompt:
18 During bone resorption, osteoclasts break down bone and release into the blood:
(Bone resorption mein osteoclasts haddi tor kar khoon mein kya chhorte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Osteoclasts haddi tor kar khoon mein calcium aur phosphate chhorte hain; yeh haddi ki growth aur marammat ke liye zaroori hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: they break down bone and release calcium and phosphate in blood

blocks.prompt:
19 The process of bone formation is called:
(Haddi banne ke amal ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Haddi banne ka amal osteogenesis hai; yeh embryo mein shuru ho kar saari zindagi jari rehta hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The process of bone formation is also called osteogenesis.

blocks.prompt:
20 The step by which cartilage is replaced by bone by the deposition of minerals is called:
(Woh qadam jis mein minerals jama ho kar cartilage ki jagah haddi ban jati hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Minerals jama hone se cartilage ki jagah haddi banna ossification kehlata hai (12.1, Fig. 12.3).

book_ref.quote: The step by which cartilage is replaced by bone by the deposition of minerals is called ossification

blocks.prompt:
21 In the formation of a long bone, when the centre of the cartilage calcifies, the chondrocytes there:
(Lambi haddi bante waqt jab cartilage ka darmiyan calcify hota hai to wahan ke chondrocytes ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: taqseem ho kar osteoclasts banate hain
mar jate hain aur khali jaghein (cavities) chhorte hain
red marrow mein badal jate hain

blocks.explanation: Calcified darmiyan ke chondrocytes mar jate hain aur khali jaghein chhorte hain; blood vessels in mein dakhil ho kar osteoblasts aur osteoclasts late hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: the chondrocytes (cartilage cells) in this area die, leaving behind cavities

blocks.prompt:
22 When a long bone is fully formed from cartilage, some cartilage remains only at the:
(Jab lambi haddi cartilage se poori ban jati hai to kuch cartilage sirf kahan reh jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saari cartilage haddi ban jati hai siwaye kuch cartilage ke jo jor (joint) ki satahon par rehti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: remains only at the articular (joint) surfaces of the bones

blocks.prompt:
23 Which bones develop directly into hard bone without forming cartilage first?
(Kaunsi haddiyan pehle cartilage banaye baghair seedhi sakht haddi ban jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch haddiyan, maslan khopri ki kuch haddiyan, seedhi haddi banti hain; femur aur humerus jaisi lambi haddiyan cartilage se banti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: some bones of the skull, develop directly into hard bone

blocks.prompt:
24 Bone remodelling after the bones are fully formed involves:
(Haddiyan poori banne ke baad bone remodelling mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: sirf osteoblasts purani haddi torte hain
yellow marrow haddi ban jata hai
osteoclasts purani haddi torte aur osteoblasts nayi haddi banate hain

blocks.explanation: Remodelling jari osteogenesis hai: osteoclasts purani haddi torte hain aur osteoblasts nayi haddi banate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: osteogenesis continues in the form of bone remodelling

blocks.prompt:
25 The layer of connective tissue that surrounds cartilage is:
(Cartilage ko gherne wali connective tissue ki teh kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Perichondrium cartilage ko gherti hai aur is mein blood vessels, lymphatic vessels aur nerves hoti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: A layer of connective tissue called perichondrium surrounds the cartilage.

blocks.prompt:
26 Cartilage heals very slowly because:
(Cartilage bohat aahista theek kyun hoti hai?)

options.text: is ke matrix mein blood vessels nahi aur cells ko diffusion se khurak milti hai
is ke matrix mein calcium phosphate crystals hain

blocks.explanation: Cartilage matrix ke andar blood vessels nahi hoti; cells ko diffusion (phailao) se khurak milti hai, is liye yeh bohat aahista theek hoti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The cells of cartilage are supplied by diffusion.

blocks.prompt:
27 Chondrocytes are:
(Chondrocytes kya hain?)

options.text: cartilage ke cells jo matrix banate aur qaim rakhte hain

blocks.explanation: Chondrocytes cartilage ke cells hain jo lacunae mein hote hain aur cartilage matrix banate aur qaim rakhte hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The cartilage cells, called chondrocytes, are present within small spaces called lacunae

blocks.prompt:
28 The most common type of cartilage, found in the nose, trachea and articulating surfaces of bones, is:
(Sab se aam cartilage jo naak, trachea aur haddiyon ki jor wali satahon par hoti hai, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyaline cartilage sab se aam hai: naak, trachea aur joints mein haddiyon ki satahein (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Hyaline cartilage is the most common type

blocks.prompt:
29 Fibrocartilage is found in:
(Fibrocartilage kahan payi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fibrocartilage zyada dabao aur khinchao wali jaghon par hoti hai, maslan intervertebral discs aur pubic symphysis (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Fibrocartilage is found in areas of the body that experience high stress

blocks.prompt:
30 The cartilage of the external ear and epiglottis is:
(Bahari kaan aur epiglottis ki cartilage kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Elastic cartilage bahari kaan aur epiglottis mein hoti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Elastic cartilage is found in the external ear and epiglottis.

blocks.prompt:
31 The cartilage matrix that gives strength, flexibility and resistance to compression is composed of:
(Cartilage matrix jo taqat, lachak aur dabao ke khilaf mazahmat deta hai, kis se bana hai?)

options.text: collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres

blocks.explanation: Cartilage matrix collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres se bana hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: composed of collagen, elastin, proteoglycans, and other fibres

blocks.prompt:
32 The human skeletal system consists of:
(Insani skeletal system mein kitni haddiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insani skeletal system mein 206 haddiyan hain, jo axial aur appendicular hisson mein hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Human skeletal system consists of 206 bones.

blocks.prompt:
33 The human skull consists of:
(Insani skull (khopri) mein kitni haddiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khopri mein 22 haddiyan hain: 8 cranial aur 14 facial (chehre ki) (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It consists of the following 22 bones

blocks.prompt:
34 Which of these is an unpaired bone of the cranium?
(In mein se cranium ki kaunsi haddi jora (pair) nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cranium ki be-jora haddiyan: frontal, occipital, ethmoid, sphenoid; parietal aur temporal jora hain; zygomatic chehre ki haddi hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The 4 unpaired bones are frontal bone, occipital bone

blocks.prompt:
35 The two unpaired facial bones are:
(Chehre ki do be-jora haddiyan kaunsi hain?)
blocks.explanation: 14 facial haddiyon mein mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer be-jora hain; baqi 6 qisam jora hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The 2 unpaired bones are mandible (jaw bone) and vomer.

blocks.prompt:
36 The middle ear ossicles are:
(Darmiyani kaan ki ossicles (chhoti haddiyan) kaunsi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Darmiyani kanon mein 6 haddiyan (3 jore) hain, yani ossicles: malleus, incus aur stapes (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These are called ossicles and include malleus, incus and stapes.

blocks.prompt:
37 The small single bone at the base of the skull below the tongue that does not articulate with any other bone of the head is:
(Khopri ki bunyad par zabaan ke neeche chhoti akeli haddi jo sar ki kisi aur haddi se jor nahi banati, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hyoid gardan ki haddi hai jo zabaan ke neeche hoti hai aur sar ki kisi haddi se jori nahi hoti (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It does not articulate with any other bone of head.

blocks.prompt:
38 The first cervical vertebra is called:
(Pehla cervical vertebra kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saat cervical (gardan ke) vertebrae mein pehla atlas aur doosra axis hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The first one is called atlas and the second one is called axis.

blocks.prompt:
39 The rib-carrying vertebrae of the chest region are the:
(Seene ke hisse ke pasliyan uthane wale vertebrae kaunse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Barah thoracic vertebrae pasliyan uthate hain aur seene ke hisse mein hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These are rib-carrying vertebrae and are found in chest region.

blocks.prompt:
40 The sacrum is formed by the fusion of:
(Sacrum kin ke jur jane se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch jure hue sacral vertebrae sacrum banate hain jo iliac haddiyon se mil kar pelvis ki pichhli taraf banata hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These are five fused vertebrae forming the sacrum.

blocks.prompt:
41 Sacral and coccygeal vertebrae are together called:
(Sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae ko mila kar kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae mil kar pelvic vertebrae kehlate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Sacral and coccygeal vertebrae are together called pelvic vertebrae.

blocks.prompt:
42 The 11th and 12th pairs of ribs are called floating ribs because they:
(11wein aur 12wein jore ki pasliyon ko floating ribs kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: alag costal cartilages se sternum se jurti hain
mushtarka costal cartilage se sternum se jurti hain

blocks.explanation: Aakhri 2 jore (11wan aur 12wan) sternum se nahi jurte, is liye floating ribs kehlate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The last 2 pairs of ribs (11th and 12th) are known as floating ribs

blocks.prompt:
43 True ribs attach to the sternum:
(True ribs sternum se kaise jurti hain?)

options.text: seedhe, alag alag costal cartilages se

blocks.explanation: Pehle 7 jore alag alag costal cartilages se seedhe sternum se jurte hain (true ribs); 8-10 aik mushtarka costal cartilage se (12.1).

book_ref.quote: attach directly with the sternum by means of separate costal cartilages

blocks.prompt:
44 The pectoral girdle consists of:
(Pectoral girdle kin haddiyon se bana hai?)

options.text: aik jora clavicles aur aik jora scapulae

blocks.explanation: Pectoral girdle mein 2 jore hain: clavicles (hasli ki haddiyan) aur scapulae (kandhe ki haddiyan) (12.1).

book_ref.quote: a pair of clavicles (collar bones) and a pair of scapulae

blocks.prompt:
45 The spherical head of the humerus fits into the:
(Humerus ka gol sar kis mein fit hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Humerus ka sar glenoid cavity mein fit hota hai; femur ka sar acetabulum mein (12.1).

book_ref.quote: which fits into the glenoid cavity

blocks.prompt:
46 The forearm bone on the outer (thumb) side is the:
(Bazu ki woh haddi jo bahari (angoothe ki) taraf hai, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ulna andar ki taraf aur radius bahar (angoothe) ki taraf hai; ulna thori bari hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: radius is on outer side (thumb side)

blocks.prompt:
47 The eight short bones of the wrist, in two rows, are the:
(Kalai ki do qataron mein aath chhoti haddiyan kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kalai mein do qataron mein aath carpals hain (book ka 'carpels' ghalat chhapa hai; carpels phool ke hisse hain) (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The eight wrist bones are the carpals

blocks.prompt:
48 The bones that make up the palm of the hand are the:
(Hatheli banane wali haddiyan kaunsi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paanch metacarpals hatheli banate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These bones make up the palm of the hand.

blocks.prompt:
49 Each forelimb (arm, wrist, hand, fingers) consists of:
(Har forelimb (bazu, kalai, haath, ungliyan) mein kitni haddiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har forelimb mein 30 haddiyan: humerus 1, ulna aur radius 2, carpals 8, metacarpals 5, phalanges 14 (12.1).

book_ref.quote: consists of the following 30 bones

blocks.prompt:
50 Each hip bone of the pelvic girdle contains three bones:
(Pelvic girdle ki har hip bone mein kaunsi teen haddiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har hip bone mein ilium, ischium aur pubis hain (book mein 'ileum' chhapa hai; ileum chhoti aant ka hissa hai) (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The hip bone is made of the ilium, ischium and pubis

blocks.prompt:
51 The bony socket in each hip bone, formed by the fusion of three bones, is the:
(Har hip bone mein teen haddiyon ke jurne se bana haddi ka socket kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har hip bone mein haddi ka socket acetabulum hai jis mein femur ka sar fit hota hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: there is a bony socket, called acetabulum

blocks.prompt:
52 The two hip bones are joined at the front by the:
(Dono hip bones aage ki taraf kis se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aage se hip bones pubic symphysis se jurti hain, jo darmiyani lakeer par pubic haddiyon ko jorne wala cartilaginous joint hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: The two hip bones are joined at the front by the pubic symphysis

blocks.prompt:
53 The patella (kneecap) is embedded in:
(Patella (ghutne ki chakni) kis mein dhansi hoti hai?)

options.text: ghutne ke upar se guzarne wala lamba tendon

blocks.explanation: Patella aik lambe tendon mein dhansi hoti hai jo ghutne ke jor ke upar se guzarta hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: It is embedded in a long tendon which runs over the knee joint.

blocks.prompt:
54 The shin bone, the large bone of the leg, is the:
(Pindli ki haddi (shin bone), taang ki bari haddi, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tibia (pindli ki haddi) taang ki bari haddi hai; fibula patli bahari haddi hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Tibia or shin bone is the large bone in the leg.

blocks.prompt:
55 The ankle is formed by:
(Takhna (ankle) kin haddiyon se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saat tarsals, chhoti haddiyan jo mazbooti se jure hain, takhna banate hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: These are short bones which are tightly attached to form the ankle.

blocks.prompt:
56 The big toe has:
(Paon ke bare angoothe mein kitni phalanges hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har ungli mein 3 phalanges hain magar bare angoothe mein 2, yun paon mein 14 phalanges (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Each toe has 3 phalanges while the big toe comprises 2 phalanges.

blocks.prompt:
57 A joint is a place where:
(Joint (jor) kya hai?)

options.text: nerve muscle mein dakhil hoti hai
red marrow yellow marrow se milta hai
do haddiyan ya haddi aur cartilage milti hain

blocks.explanation: Joint woh jagah hai jahan do haddiyan ya haddi aur cartilage milti hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: A joint is a place where two bones or bone and cartilage come together.

blocks.prompt:
58 In fibrous joints the bones are connected by fibrous connective tissue consisting mainly of:
(Fibrous joints mein haddiyan jis fibrous connective tissue se jurti hain woh zyada tar kis ka bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fibrous joints mein haddiyan seedhe fibrous connective tissue (zyada tar collagen) se jurti hain aur koi harkat nahi hoti (12.1).

book_ref.quote: by fibrous connective tissue consisting mainly of collagen

blocks.prompt:
59 Sutures are fibrous joints found only between the:
(Sutures fibrous joints hain jo sirf kahan hote hain?)

options.text: khopri ki na hilne wali haddiyan

blocks.explanation: Sutures sirf khopri ki na hilne wali haddiyon ke darmiyan hote hain (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Sutures that occur only between the immovable bones of the skull.

blocks.prompt:
60 The joint between the first rib and the sternum is a cartilaginous joint in which the bones are connected by:
(Pehli pasli aur sternum ka jor cartilaginous joint hai jis mein haddiyan kis se jurti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch cartilaginous joints, maslan pehli pasli aur sternum, hyaline cartilage se jurte hain; pubic symphysis mein fibrocartilage hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: For example, the joint between the first rib and sternum.

blocks.prompt:
61 In a synovial joint, the ends of the bones are covered by articular cartilage, which is:
(Synovial joint mein haddiyon ke sire articular cartilage se dhake hote hain; yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Articular cartilage chikni, sakht aur lachakdar hyaline cartilage hai jo harkat ke liye bina ragar ki satah deti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: called articular cartilage, covers the ends of the bones in the joint

blocks.prompt:
62 Synovial fluid that lubricates a synovial joint is secreted by the:
(Synovial joint ko chikna karne wala synovial fluid kaun kharij karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fibrous capsule ki bahari teh ligaments aur andaruni teh synovial membrane hai jo synovial fluid kharij karti hai (12.1).

book_ref.quote: inner lining of synovial membrane, which secretes synovial fluid

blocks.prompt:
63 Based on the range of motion, synovial joints are of:
(Harkat ki had ke lihaz se synovial joints kitni qisam ke hain?)
blocks.explanation: Synovial joints ki chhe bari qismein hain: ball-and-socket, hinge, pivot, ellipsoidal, saddle aur gliding (12.1).

book_ref.quote: There are six main types of synovial joints based on the range of motion.

blocks.prompt:
64 A joint that allows motion in all directions, as in the shoulder and hip, is a:
(Woh joint jo har simt mein harkat de, jaise kandha aur koolha, kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ball-and-socket joints har simt mein harkat dete hain, maslan kandhe aur koolhe ke jor (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Ball-and-socket joints allow motion in all directions

blocks.prompt:
65 The joint between the first and second vertebrae of the neck is a:
(Gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebra ka jor kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pivot joints aik hi axis ke gird ghumao dete hain, maslan gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebra ke darmiyan (12.1).

book_ref.quote: Pivot joints allow rotational movement around a single axis

blocks.prompt:
66 The thumb joint, where one bone has a concave and the other a convex surface, is a:
(Angoothe ka jor, jahan aik haddi ki satah concave aur doosri ki convex hai, kis qisam ka hai?)

128 Tetanus mainly affects the muscles of the:
(Tetanus zyada tar kin muscles par asar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetanus zyada tar jabre aur gardan ke muscles par asar karta hai, jab ke tetany haath, paon, chehre ya larynx par (12.3).

book_ref.quote: Tetanus mainly affects the jaw and neck muscles.

blocks.prompt:
129 A muscle cannot push. After it contracts, it is lengthened again by:
(Muscle dhakel nahi sakta. Sukarne ke baad yeh dobara lamba kaise hota hai?)

options.text: khud ba khud lamba ho kar

blocks.explanation: Muscle fibres sirf khud sukar (khainch) sakte hain; mukhalif antagonistic muscle ka khinchao dheele muscle ko dobara lamba karta hai (12.3, book correction).

book_ref.quote: it is lengthened again by the pull of the opposing (antagonistic) muscle

blocks.prompt:
130 When the skeleton works as a system of rods and levers, the joints serve as:
(Jab skeleton rods aur levers ke nizam ki tarah kaam kare to joints kya kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Haddiyan rods, joints fulcrum (dhuri), muscles effort (quwwat) aur hilaya jane wala wazan load hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: joints serve as fulcrums (pivot points) for the levers

blocks.prompt:
131 When a weight is lifted by bending the elbow, the lever is:
(Kohni mor kar wazan uthate waqt lever kya hai?)

options.text: bazu ki nichli haddiyan (radius aur ulna)

blocks.explanation: Book correction: lever bazu ki nichli haddiyan (radius aur ulna) hain; kohni fulcrum, biceps effort aur wazan load hai (12.3).

book_ref.quote: the forearm bones (radius and ulna) act as the lever
